s1.syndrome_frame: A firm, fixed mass in the breast with a history of prior breast cancer treatment
salient_findings: 20 mm firm mass fixed to the pectoralis major muscle
Focal asymmetrical density in the retromammary space on mammography
Lobulated, well-defined mass with heterogeneous internal echoes on ultrasonography
key_facts: 59-year-old woman
Lump in the lower outer quadrant of her left breast
History of breast-conserving surgery, endocrine therapy, and radiation to the left breast
Prior carcinoma in the upper inner quadrant of the left breast
Mass is fixed to the pectoralis major muscle
Overlying skin is uninvolved
No palpable axillary lymph nodes
Mammography showed a focal asymmetrical density
Ultrasonography revealed a lobulated, well-defined mass
Core-needle biopsy suggested atrophic mammary glands
Lesion increased in size on three-month follow-up

shortlist.label: Locoregional breast cancer recurrence
shortlist.why_kept: History of prior breast cancer and presentation of a new, fixed mass in the same breast

shortlist.label: Sarcoma of the breast
shortlist.why_kept: Rapid growth of the mass and prior radiation therapy increasing the risk of secondary sarcoma

shortlist.label: Phyllodes tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Lobulated, well-defined mass with heterogeneous internal echoes on ultrasonography, consistent with phyllodes tumor characteristics

shortlist.label: Fat necrosis
shortlist.why_kept: History of prior breast surgery and radiation, which can lead to fat necrosis

shortlist.label: Atypical lipomatous tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Presentation of a firm, fixed mass with a history of prior breast cancer treatment, which could be a rare but plausible diagnosis

raw.rationale: The patient has a history of breast-conserving surgery, endocrine therapy, and radiation to the left breast for a prior carcinoma, and now presents with a new lump in the same breast, which has increased in size on follow-up, suggesting a possible recurrence.

rejected.label: Sarcoma of the breast
rejected.why: While possible, sarcomas are rare and the patient's history of breast cancer and radiation therapy makes recurrence more likely

rejected.label: Phyllodes tumor
rejected.why: The biopsy results and imaging findings do not specifically suggest a phyllodes tumor

rejected.label: Fat necrosis
rejected.why: The lesion's location, size increase, and fixation to the pectoralis major muscle are not typical of fat necrosis

rejected.label: Atypical lipomatous tumor
rejected.why: The imaging findings and biopsy results do not suggest a lipomatous tumor
